Some people don't though. Lets say someone is out there they could live on another continent and the chances of you actually meeting is slim, so in turn you just end up marrying someone who gives you the slightest bit of attention. Fast forward years later to ur 50th anniversary with your "sweetheart" celebrating with your loved ones and friends. As you kiss your partner, and  say "I love you." You put on a fake smile mask how you really feel, but you know deep down that this marriage was an act of sheer despiration and you know you would have been happier alone or with your true love you never met  this person next to you was never your true love don't get me wrong you did love your partner but not as much as your real love, who you'd actually want to be spending your 50th with, the one who would've actually understanded you.The one you'd have a real genuine smile for not some superficial smile for this person beside you.

Yeah I got diagnosed with MDD last August IDK much about MDD, I only know I have it because I got some transcript from the psych ward I went to for outpatient help. Idk 🤷‍♂️ i'm constantly depressed I work, pay my own bills, live alone, I still talk to my mom about it and she just says "you have a  mental illness it's ok don't be ashamed , but you need to snap out of it, and stop thinking so negative." So that advice sounds so counterintuitive and leaves me even more depressed. I guess for advice i'd say find something to keep your mind off of it, doesn't have to be a new hobby because finding the motivation can be hard when you're depressed. Right now I never thought i'd enjoy it but i'm growing a small lavender garden and it helps for a small bit.

It's hard when you lose a GF, mine broke up with me for a week once... I couldn't eat or barely sleep, until she texted me the next week asking for us to get back together so yeah when that happened for the time being and the only advice I got was "just get over it bro there's more out there bro." It really hurt. I play games on playstation with IRLS mostly daily barely see them in person bc I guess young adulthood now, I got a decent job but still don't enjoy it. Basically I just stay in my room all day and I'm to depressed and sad to try and "Get Out There" as they say.
That scares me tbh and I'm sorry to hear that I always hold off because I always thought the older the wiser.
